title: Sparse Routing Adapters for Low-Resource Translation
method: We propose Sparse Routing Adapters (SRA): each transformer layer gets 8 small bottleneck adapters and a learned router that activates the top-2 adapters per token.
datasets: We evaluate on FLORES-200 (Nepali-English, Sinhala-English) and on the IWSLT 2017 Kazakh-English test set.
metrics: We report chrF++ and BLEU, averaged over three seeds.
main_result: SRA reaches 41.2 chrF++ on Nepali-English, +2.7 over plain adapters and within 0.4 of full fine-tuning, while training 3.1% of the parameters.
